label: an hourglass.
why: An hourglass in a frame stands against a bright circle while a hand turns it over, sets it down upright and withdraws, after which sand runs. The interval starts mid-flip just after the frame-difference spikes at 20.0 s and 20.75 s, which mark the hand entering and the fast turn, and ends before the dissolve to the archway that starts near 25.5 s.
